_readme: Copy this to config.json (the master auto-copies it on first run). Connect Jira/Confluence/Sentry/GitHub/Telegram and your backend URLs from the dashboard: Accounts → Connect your accounts. Secrets live in the gitignored secrets.json — never here.
_accounts: Each runner is an AI CLI login profile. Set pace/effort/cap PER ACCOUNT on the dashboard. Log each Claude profile in once: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<dir> claude /login. Codex/Gemini: pick 'other' and give the run command (gets the task in $WORKER_PROMPT).
_comment: kind=agent are team roles; kind=job are granular tasks. Schedule with everyMinutes OR atHHMM; manual=true runs only on -run. The prompt files under agents/ and jobs/ are EXAMPLES — edit them to describe YOUR project, conventions and gates.
_monitor: Your backend / servers to health-check. Edit here or from Accounts → Connect → 'Backend / services to watch'.
